items.question: Trong câu "A container packages an application with its user-space dependencies (runtime, libraries, config) into one immutable image that runs the same way on any Linux host.", từ "package" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A container packages an application with its user-space dependencies (runtime, libraries, config) into one immutable image that runs the same way on any Linux host.", what does "package" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: package /ˈpækɪdʒ/ (động từ): đóng gói. "Package X into Y" = đóng gói X thành Y; ở đây ứng dụng và phụ thuộc được gói vào một image.
items.explanationEn: package /ˈpækɪdʒ/ (verb): to bundle into one unit. "Package X into Y" means bundling X into a single unit Y; here the app and its dependencies go into one image.

items.question: Trong câu "A container packages an application with its user-space dependencies (runtime, libraries, config) into one immutable image that runs the same way on any Linux host.", từ "immutable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A container packages an application with its user-space dependencies (runtime, libraries, config) into one immutable image that runs the same way on any Linux host.", what does "immutable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: immutable /ɪˈmjuːtəbl/ (tính từ): không thể thay đổi. Đối nghĩa là "mutable"; "immutable image/tag" là thứ đã tạo thì không sửa được.
items.explanationEn: immutable /ɪˈmjuːtəbl/ (adjective): unable to be changed. The opposite is "mutable"; an "immutable image/tag" cannot be modified once created.

items.question: Trong câu "A container packages an application with its user-space dependencies (runtime, libraries, config) into one immutable image that runs the same way on any Linux host.", từ "dependency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A container packages an application with its user-space dependencies (runtime, libraries, config) into one immutable image that runs the same way on any Linux host.", what does "dependency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: dependency /dɪˈpendənsi/ (danh từ): thứ phụ thuộc cần có. Trong phần mềm, "dependencies" là thư viện/gói mà ứng dụng cần; "install dependencies" = cài các gói phụ thuộc.
items.explanationEn: dependency /dɪˈpendənsi/ (noun): something software needs to run. In software, "dependencies" are the libraries or packages an app needs; "install dependencies" is a common phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "Architects combine both: containers for packaging and density, VMs or micro-VMs (e.g. Firecracker, which isolates AWS Lambda functions) for hard multi-tenant boundaries.", từ "density" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Architects combine both: containers for packaging and density, VMs or micro-VMs (e.g. Firecracker, which isolates AWS Lambda functions) for hard multi-tenant boundaries.", what does "density" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: density /ˈdensəti/ (danh từ): mật độ. "Density" ở đây là chạy được nhiều ứng dụng trên cùng một máy; "high density" = mật độ cao.
items.explanationEn: density /ˈdensəti/ (noun): how tightly things are packed. Here "density" means fitting many workloads on one machine; "high density" is the usual collocation.

items.question: Trong câu "Architects combine both: containers for packaging and density, VMs or micro-VMs (e.g. Firecracker, which isolates AWS Lambda functions) for hard multi-tenant boundaries.", từ "boundary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Architects combine both: containers for packaging and density, VMs or micro-VMs (e.g. Firecracker, which isolates AWS Lambda functions) for hard multi-tenant boundaries.", what does "boundary" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: boundary /ˈbaʊndri/ (danh từ): ranh giới. "Security/isolation boundary" = ranh giới bảo mật/cô lập giữa các khách hàng hoặc tiến trình.
items.explanationEn: boundary /ˈbaʊndri/ (noun): a dividing limit. "Security boundary" or "isolation boundary" is the line that separates tenants or processes.

items.question: Trong câu "Docker does not enable the user namespace by default (only with userns-remap or rootless mode), so root in a container is UID 0 on the host kernel, restrained by dropped capabilities, seccomp and AppArmor/SELinux.", từ "restrain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Docker does not enable the user namespace by default (only with userns-remap or rootless mode), so root in a container is UID 0 on the host kernel, restrained by dropped capabilities, seccomp and AppArmor/SELinux.", what does "restrain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: restrain /rɪˈstreɪn/ (động từ): kiềm chế, hạn chế. "Restrained by X" = bị X kìm hãm; root trong container vẫn bị giới hạn bởi các cơ chế bảo mật.
items.explanationEn: restrain /rɪˈstreɪn/ (verb): to hold back, to limit. "Restrained by X" means held back by X; container root is still limited by security mechanisms.

items.question: Trong câu "Hardening is topic 5.", từ "hardening" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hardening is topic 5.", what does "hardening" (noun) mean?
options: gia cố bảo mật hệ thống
items.explanation: hardening /ˈhɑːdnɪŋ/ (danh từ): gia cố bảo mật hệ thống. "Security hardening" = gia cố, giảm bề mặt tấn công; khác với nghĩa "làm cứng" kim loại.
items.explanationEn: hardening /ˈhɑːdnɪŋ/ (noun): making a system more secure. "Security hardening" means reducing attack surface; it differs from the physical sense of hardening metal.

items.question: Trong câu "Current distributions use cgroup v2, supported by Docker since 20.10.", từ "distribution" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Current distributions use cgroup v2, supported by Docker since 20.10.", what does "distribution" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: distribution /ˌdɪstrɪˈbjuːʃn/ (danh từ): bản phân phối (Linux). "Linux distribution" (distro) như Ubuntu, Debian; từ này còn có nghĩa "sự phân phối" hàng hóa.
items.explanationEn: distribution /ˌdɪstrɪˈbjuːʃn/ (noun): a packaged OS release. A "Linux distribution" (distro) is e.g. Ubuntu or Debian; the word also means delivering goods.

items.question: Trong câu "CPU is compressible: over quota, the container is throttled (slower, not dead).", từ "compressible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CPU is compressible: over quota, the container is throttled (slower, not dead).", what does "compressible" (adjective) mean?
options: có thể co giãn, nén lại
items.explanation: compressible /kəmˈpresəbl/ (tính từ): có thể co giãn, nén lại. Tài nguyên "compressible" như CPU có thể bị giảm bớt mà tiến trình không chết.
items.explanationEn: compressible /kəmˈpresəbl/ (adjective): able to be squeezed smaller. A "compressible" resource like CPU can be reduced without killing the process.

items.question: Trong câu "CPU is compressible: over quota, the container is throttled (slower, not dead).", từ "quota" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CPU is compressible: over quota, the container is throttled (slower, not dead).", what does "quota" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: quota /ˈkwəʊtə/ (danh từ): hạn mức. "Over quota" = vượt hạn mức; "set a quota" = đặt hạn mức sử dụng.
items.explanationEn: quota /ˈkwəʊtə/ (noun): an allowed maximum amount. "Over quota" means exceeding the allowed amount; "set a quota" is a common phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "CPU is compressible: over quota, the container is throttled (slower, not dead).", từ "throttle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CPU is compressible: over quota, the container is throttled (slower, not dead).", what does "throttle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: throttle /ˈθrɒtl/ (động từ): bóp, giới hạn tốc độ. "Be throttled" = bị giới hạn tốc độ/lưu lượng; nghĩa gốc là bóp cổ hoặc van tiết lưu.
items.explanationEn: throttle /ˈθrɒtl/ (verb): to deliberately slow down. "Be throttled" means having speed or throughput limited; the literal sense is to choke.

items.question: Trong câu "The two resources fail differently — a favourite troubleshooting question:", từ "troubleshooting" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The two resources fail differently — a favourite troubleshooting question:", what does "troubleshooting" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: troubleshooting /ˈtrʌblʃuːtɪŋ/ (danh từ): xử lý sự cố. "Troubleshooting guide/question" = hướng dẫn/câu hỏi chẩn đoán và khắc phục lỗi.
items.explanationEn: troubleshooting /ˈtrʌblʃuːtɪŋ/ (noun): finding and fixing faults. A "troubleshooting guide" or "question" is about diagnosing and fixing problems.

items.question: Trong câu "With no flags a container may use all host CPU and memory, so one leaking container can starve a node.", từ "starve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With no flags a container may use all host CPU and memory, so one leaking container can starve a node.", what does "starve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: starve /stɑːv/ (động từ): làm thiếu tài nguyên. Trong máy tính, "starve X" = khiến X không nhận đủ CPU/bộ nhớ; nghĩa gốc là bỏ đói.
items.explanationEn: starve /stɑːv/ (verb): to deprive of resources. In computing, "starve X" means X gets too little CPU or memory; the literal sense is lack of food.

items.question: Trong câu "With no flags a container may use all host CPU and memory, so one leaking container can starve a node.", từ "leak" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With no flags a container may use all host CPU and memory, so one leaking container can starve a node.", what does "leak" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: leak /liːk/ (động từ): rò rỉ (bộ nhớ). "Memory leak" = rò rỉ bộ nhớ; "leak" cũng có nghĩa làm lộ thông tin ra ngoài.
items.explanationEn: leak /liːk/ (verb): to lose memory over time. A "memory leak" is memory never freed; "leak" also means revealing information.

items.question: Trong câu "docker CLI — only a client; docker context can point it at a remote engine.", từ "remote" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "docker CLI — only a client; docker context can point it at a remote engine.", what does "remote" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: remote /rɪˈməʊt/ (tính từ): từ xa. "Remote server/engine" = máy chủ ở máy khác, truy cập qua mạng; "remote village" = làng hẻo lánh.
items.explanationEn: remote /rɪˈməʊt/ (adjective): located on another machine. A "remote server" is on another machine reached over a network; a "remote village" is isolated.

items.question: Trong câu "dockerd — the daemon.", từ "daemon" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "dockerd — the daemon.", what does "daemon" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: daemon /ˈdiːmən/ (danh từ): tiến trình chạy nền. Trong Unix, "daemon" là chương trình chạy nền (thường kết thúc bằng "d" như dockerd, sshd).
items.explanationEn: daemon /ˈdiːmən/ (noun): a background service process. In Unix, a "daemon" is a background program, often named with a trailing "d" like dockerd or sshd.

items.question: Trong câu "containerd — CNCF runtime managing images and lifecycles; Kubernetes uses it directly via CRI.", từ "lifecycle" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "containerd — CNCF runtime managing images and lifecycles; Kubernetes uses it directly via CRI.", what does "lifecycle" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: lifecycle /ˈlaɪfsaɪkl/ (danh từ): vòng đời. "Container lifecycle" = vòng đời container: tạo, chạy, dừng, xóa.
items.explanationEn: lifecycle /ˈlaɪfsaɪkl/ (noun): stages from creation to removal. The "container lifecycle" covers create, start, stop and remove.

items.question: Trong câu "runc — the low-level OCI runtime that makes the kernel calls.", từ "low-level" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "runc — the low-level OCI runtime that makes the kernel calls.", what does "low-level" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: close to the OS or hardware
items.explanation: low-level /ˌləʊ ˈlevl/ (tính từ): cấp thấp (gần phần cứng). "Low-level" = làm việc gần nhân/phần cứng; đối lập với "high-level" (trừu tượng hơn).
items.explanationEn: low-level /ˌləʊ ˈlevl/ (adjective): close to the OS or hardware. "Low-level" means close to the kernel or hardware; the opposite is "high-level".

items.question: Trong câu "The Open Container Initiative (OCI) standardises image format, runtime and registry API.", từ "standardise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The Open Container Initiative (OCI) standardises image format, runtime and registry API.", what does "standardise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: standardise /ˈstændədaɪz/ (động từ): chuẩn hóa. "Standardise" (Anh-Anh) / "standardize" (Anh-Mỹ) = đặt ra chuẩn chung để các bên tương thích.
items.explanationEn: standardise /ˈstændədaɪz/ (verb): to make uniform by rules. "Standardise" (UK) or "standardize" (US) means setting common rules so tools interoperate.

items.question: Trong câu "That is why an image from docker build runs unchanged on containerd, CRI-O or Podman", từ "unchanged" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is why an image from docker build runs unchanged on containerd, CRI-O or Podman", what does "unchanged" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unchanged /ʌnˈtʃeɪndʒd/ (tính từ): không cần sửa đổi. "Run unchanged" = chạy nguyên trạng, không cần chỉnh sửa gì.
items.explanationEn: unchanged /ʌnˈtʃeɪndʒd/ (adjective): without any modification. "Run unchanged" means working as-is, with no modification needed.

items.question: Trong câu "Security: the Docker socket is root-equivalent.", từ "equivalent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Security: the Docker socket is root-equivalent.", what does "equivalent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: equivalent /ɪˈkwɪvələnt/ (tính từ): tương đương. "X-equivalent" = có tác dụng như X; "root-equivalent" = quyền ngang root.
items.explanationEn: equivalent /ɪˈkwɪvələnt/ (adjective): equal in effect. "X-equivalent" means having the same effect as X; "root-equivalent" means as powerful as root.

items.question: Trong câu "Whoever can reach it (or an unprotected TCP port 2375) can start a container that mounts the host's /.", từ "unprotected" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Whoever can reach it (or an unprotected TCP port 2375) can start a container that mounts the host's /.", what does "unprotected" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unprotected /ˌʌnprəˈtektɪd/ (tính từ): không được bảo vệ. "Unprotected port/endpoint" = cổng không có xác thực hay mã hóa, ai cũng truy cập được.
items.explanationEn: unprotected /ˌʌnprəˈtektɪd/ (adjective): left without security. An "unprotected port" has no authentication or encryption, so anyone can reach it.

items.question: Trong câu "Whoever can reach it (or an unprotected TCP port 2375) can start a container that mounts the host's /.", từ "mount" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Whoever can reach it (or an unprotected TCP port 2375) can start a container that mounts the host's /.", what does "mount" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mount /maʊnt/ (động từ): gắn (hệ thống tệp). "Mount a volume/directory" = gắn thư mục vào một đường dẫn; "mount a horse" = lên ngựa.
items.explanationEn: mount /maʊnt/ (verb): to attach a filesystem. "Mount a volume" attaches storage at a path; "mount a horse" means getting on it.

items.question: Trong câu "At run time the storage driver (overlay2 by default) merges layers into one view and adds a thin writable layer per container:", từ "merge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "At run time the storage driver (overlay2 by default) merges layers into one view and adds a thin writable layer per container:", what does "merge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: merge /mɜːdʒ/ (động từ): hợp nhất. "Merge A into B" = gộp A vào B; "merge a branch" = gộp nhánh trong Git.
items.explanationEn: merge /mɜːdʒ/ (verb): to combine into one. "Merge A into B" means combining them; "merge a branch" is common in Git.

items.question: Trong câu "At run time the storage driver (overlay2 by default) merges layers into one view and adds a thin writable layer per container:", từ "thin" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "At run time the storage driver (overlay2 by default) merges layers into one view and adds a thin writable layer per container:", what does "thin" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: thin /θɪn/ (tính từ): mỏng, nhẹ. "Thin layer/client" = lớp/thành phần mỏng, ít dữ liệu; "thin person" = người gầy.
items.explanationEn: thin /θɪn/ (adjective): having little size or weight. A "thin layer" or "thin client" holds little; a "thin person" is slim.

items.question: Trong câu "Copy-on-write: modifying a file from a lower layer first copies it up into the writable layer.", từ "modify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Copy-on-write: modifying a file from a lower layer first copies it up into the writable layer.", what does "modify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: modify /ˈmɒdɪfaɪ/ (động từ): sửa đổi. "Modify a file" = chỉnh sửa tệp; danh từ là "modification".
items.explanationEn: modify /ˈmɒdɪfaɪ/ (verb): to change. "Modify a file" means changing it; the noun is "modification".

items.question: Trong câu "Heavy writes inside the container filesystem are slow and vanish when the container is removed — use volumes.", từ "vanish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Heavy writes inside the container filesystem are slow and vanish when the container is removed — use volumes.", what does "vanish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: vanish /ˈvænɪʃ/ (động từ): biến mất. "Vanish" = biến mất hoàn toàn, thường đột ngột; "vanish without a trace" = biến mất không dấu vết.
items.explanationEn: vanish /ˈvænɪʃ/ (verb): to disappear. "Vanish" means disappearing completely; "vanish without a trace" is a common phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "Deleting a file in a later layer does not shrink the image; the bytes stay in the earlier layer behind a "whiteout".", từ "shrink" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Deleting a file in a later layer does not shrink the image; the bytes stay in the earlier layer behind a "whiteout".", what does "shrink" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (động từ): làm nhỏ lại. "Shrink the image/disk" = giảm kích thước; đối nghĩa là "grow" hoặc "expand".
items.explanationEn: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (verb): to make smaller. "Shrink the image" means reducing its size; the opposite is "grow" or "expand".

items.question: Trong câu "docker image history my-api:1.4.0 lists each layer, its size and the instruction that created it.", từ "instruction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "docker image history my-api:1.4.0 lists each layer, its size and the instruction that created it.", what does "instruction" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: advice on how to do something
a directive in a build file
items.explanation: instruction /ɪnˈstrʌkʃn/ (danh từ): câu lệnh (trong tệp cấu hình). Trong Dockerfile, mỗi dòng như RUN, COPY là một "instruction"; "follow the instructions" = làm theo hướng dẫn.
items.explanationEn: instruction /ɪnˈstrʌkʃn/ (noun): a directive in a build file. In a Dockerfile each line like RUN or COPY is an "instruction"; "follow the instructions" means obey guidance.

items.question: Trong câu "ADD also fetches URLs and auto-extracts tars — prefer COPY", từ "fetch" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "ADD also fetches URLs and auto-extracts tars — prefer COPY", what does "fetch" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to go and pick someone up
items.explanation: fetch /fetʃ/ (động từ): tải về, lấy về. "Fetch data/a URL" = lấy dữ liệu từ nguồn; "fetch a good price" = bán được giá cao.
items.explanationEn: fetch /fetʃ/ (verb): to retrieve from a source. "Fetch a URL" means retrieving its content; "fetch a good price" means selling well.

items.question: Trong câu "ADD also fetches URLs and auto-extracts tars — prefer COPY", từ "prefer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "ADD also fetches URLs and auto-extracts tars — prefer COPY", what does "prefer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prefer /prɪˈfɜː(r)/ (động từ): ưu tiên dùng. "Prefer X (over Y)" = ưu tiên X hơn Y; hay gặp trong hướng dẫn best practice.
items.explanationEn: prefer /prɪˈfɜː(r)/ (verb): to choose first. "Prefer X over Y" means choosing X first; common in best-practice guides.

items.question: Trong câu "Chain related steps with &&", từ "chain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Chain related steps with &&", what does "chain" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to tie with a metal chain
items.explanation: chain /tʃeɪn/ (động từ): nối liên tiếp. "Chain commands" = nối các lệnh chạy nối tiếp; "chain a dog" = xích con chó.
items.explanationEn: chain /tʃeɪn/ (verb): to link in sequence. "Chain commands" means running them in sequence; "chain a dog" means tying it up.

items.question: Trong câu "the shell can stay PID 1 and does not forward SIGTERM, so docker stop waits out the grace period and then kills", từ "forward" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the shell can stay PID 1 and does not forward SIGTERM, so docker stop waits out the grace period and then kills", what does "forward" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: forward /ˈfɔːwəd/ (động từ): chuyển tiếp. "Forward a signal/email/port" = chuyển tiếp tín hiệu/email/cổng sang nơi khác.
items.explanationEn: forward /ˈfɔːwəd/ (verb): to pass on to another. "Forward a signal", "an email" or "a port" means passing it on elsewhere.

items.question: Trong câu "the shell can stay PID 1 and does not forward SIGTERM, so docker stop waits out the grace period and then kills", từ "grace period" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the shell can stay PID 1 and does not forward SIGTERM, so docker stop waits out the grace period and then kills", what does "grace period" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: grace period /ˈɡreɪs pɪəriəd/ (cụm từ): thời gian ân hạn. "Grace period" = khoảng thời gian cho phép trước khi áp dụng biện pháp mạnh (ví dụ kill tiến trình).
items.explanationEn: grace period /ˈɡreɪs pɪəriəd/ (phrase): extra time before enforcement. A "grace period" is allowed time before a hard action, such as killing a process.

items.question: Trong câu "the shell can stay PID 1 and does not forward SIGTERM, so docker stop waits out the grace period and then kills", từ "wait out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the shell can stay PID 1 and does not forward SIGTERM, so docker stop waits out the grace period and then kills", what does "wait out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: wait out /weɪt aʊt/ (cụm từ): chờ cho hết. "Wait out X" = kiên nhẫn chờ cho đến khi X kết thúc; "wait out the storm" = chờ bão tan.
items.explanationEn: wait out /weɪt aʊt/ (phrase): to wait until it ends. "Wait out X" means waiting until X is over; "wait out the storm" is a common phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "A hit reuses it.", từ "hit" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A hit reuses it.", what does "hit" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hit /hɪt/ (danh từ): lần trúng (cache). "Cache hit" = tìm thấy trong cache; đối nghĩa "cache miss". Từ này còn nghĩa "cú đánh", "bản hit".
items.explanationEn: hit /hɪt/ (noun): a successful cache lookup. A "cache hit" finds the entry; the opposite is a "cache miss". It also means a blow or a popular song.

items.question: Trong câu "The first miss invalidates every later instruction.", từ "invalidate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The first miss invalidates every later instruction.", what does "invalidate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: invalidate /ɪnˈvælɪdeɪt/ (động từ): làm mất hiệu lực. "Invalidate the cache" = làm cache không còn dùng được; danh từ "cache invalidation".
items.explanationEn: invalidate /ɪnˈvælɪdeɪt/ (verb): to make no longer valid. "Invalidate the cache" makes stored results unusable; the noun is "cache invalidation".

items.question: Trong câu "RUN — matched on the command string only, so RUN apt-get update stays cached even when upstream changed.", từ "upstream" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "RUN — matched on the command string only, so RUN apt-get update stays cached even when upstream changed.", what does "upstream" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the upper part of a river
items.explanation: upstream /ˌʌpˈstriːm/ (danh từ): nguồn gốc phía trên. Trong phần mềm, "upstream" là nguồn gốc (kho gói, dự án gốc); nghĩa đen là thượng nguồn.
items.explanationEn: upstream /ˌʌpˈstriːm/ (noun): the original source project. In software, "upstream" is the original source such as a package repo; literally, the upper river.

items.question: Trong câu "COPY / ADD — matched on a checksum of file contents (mtimes ignored).", từ "checksum" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "COPY / ADD — matched on a checksum of file contents (mtimes ignored).", what does "checksum" (noun) mean?
options: giá trị kiểm tra toàn vẹn
items.explanation: checksum /ˈtʃeksʌm/ (danh từ): giá trị kiểm tra toàn vẹn. "Checksum" tính từ nội dung; nội dung đổi thì checksum đổi, nên dùng để phát hiện thay đổi.
items.explanationEn: checksum /ˈtʃeksʌm/ (noun): a value to verify data. A "checksum" is computed from content; if content changes, the checksum changes.

items.question: Trong câu "COPY / ADD — matched on a checksum of file contents (mtimes ignored).", từ "ignore" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "COPY / ADD — matched on a checksum of file contents (mtimes ignored).", what does "ignore" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ignore /ɪɡˈnɔː(r)/ (động từ): bỏ qua. "X ignored" = X không được tính đến; ".dockerignore" liệt kê tệp bị bỏ qua.
items.explanationEn: ignore /ɪɡˈnɔː(r)/ (verb): to pay no attention to. "X ignored" means X is not considered; ".dockerignore" lists files to leave out.

items.question: Trong câu "Rules: least-changing things first, source code last; apt-get update && apt-get install -y … in one RUN; keep the build context small (.dockerignore, topic 5).", từ "context" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rules: least-changing things first, source code last; apt-get update && apt-get install -y … in one RUN; keep the build context small (.dockerignore, topic 5).", what does "context" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: context /ˈkɒntekst/ (danh từ): tập tệp gửi cho build. "Build context" = thư mục tệp gửi cho builder; "in context" = trong ngữ cảnh.
items.explanationEn: context /ˈkɒntekst/ (noun): files sent to the builder. The "build context" is the set of files sent to the builder; "in context" means in its surroundings.

items.question: Trong câu "CI runners start with an empty cache — BuildKit can store it in a registry with --cache-to / --cache-from.", từ "runner" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CI runners start with an empty cache — BuildKit can store it in a registry with --cache-to / --cache-from.", what does "runner" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: runner /ˈrʌnə(r)/ (danh từ): máy chạy tác vụ CI. "CI runner" = máy/agent thực thi pipeline; nghĩa thường là người chạy bộ.
items.explanationEn: runner /ˈrʌnə(r)/ (noun): a machine executing CI jobs. A "CI runner" is an agent that executes pipeline jobs; normally it means a person running.

items.question: Trong câu "--no-cache forces a clean build.", từ "force" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "--no-cache forces a clean build.", what does "force" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: force /fɔːs/ (động từ): buộc phải xảy ra. "Force a rebuild/refresh" = bắt buộc làm lại; "force the door" = phá cửa.
items.explanationEn: force /fɔːs/ (verb): to make something happen. "Force a rebuild" makes it happen regardless; "force the door" means breaking it open.

items.question: Trong câu "docker kill sends SIGKILL at once.", từ "at once" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "docker kill sends SIGKILL at once.", what does "at once" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at once /æt wʌns/ (cụm từ): ngay lập tức. "At once" thường là "ngay lập tức"; nhưng "all at once" lại là "cùng một lúc".
items.explanationEn: at once /æt wʌns/ (phrase): immediately. "At once" usually means immediately; "all at once" means simultaneously.

items.question: Trong câu "Apps should catch SIGTERM, stop accepting work, drain in-flight requests and exit — orchestrators rely on this for rolling deploys.", từ "drain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Apps should catch SIGTERM, stop accepting work, drain in-flight requests and exit — orchestrators rely on this for rolling deploys.", what does "drain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: drain /dreɪn/ (động từ): xử lý nốt cho hết. "Drain connections/a node" = xử lý xong phần đang dở rồi ngừng nhận mới; nghĩa đen là tháo nước.
items.explanationEn: drain /dreɪn/ (verb): to finish off remaining work. "Drain connections" or "a node" means finishing current work before stopping; literally, emptying water.

items.question: Trong câu "Apps should catch SIGTERM, stop accepting work, drain in-flight requests and exit — orchestrators rely on this for rolling deploys.", từ "in-flight" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Apps should catch SIGTERM, stop accepting work, drain in-flight requests and exit — orchestrators rely on this for rolling deploys.", what does "in-flight" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: in-flight /ˌɪn ˈflaɪt/ (tính từ): đang được xử lý dở. "In-flight requests" = request đang xử lý giữa chừng; "in-flight meal" = suất ăn trên máy bay.
items.explanationEn: in-flight /ˌɪn ˈflaɪt/ (adjective): currently being processed. "In-flight requests" are those mid-processing; an "in-flight meal" is served on a plane.

items.question: Trong câu "Apps should catch SIGTERM, stop accepting work, drain in-flight requests and exit — orchestrators rely on this for rolling deploys.", từ "orchestrator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Apps should catch SIGTERM, stop accepting work, drain in-flight requests and exit — orchestrators rely on this for rolling deploys.", what does "orchestrator" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: orchestrator /ˈɔːkɪstreɪtə(r)/ (danh từ): hệ thống điều phối. "Container orchestrator" như Kubernetes tự lên lịch, khởi động lại, mở rộng container.
items.explanationEn: orchestrator /ˈɔːkɪstreɪtə(r)/ (noun): a system coordinating services. A "container orchestrator" such as Kubernetes schedules, restarts and scales containers.

items.question: Trong câu "Apps should catch SIGTERM, stop accepting work, drain in-flight requests and exit — orchestrators rely on this for rolling deploys.", từ "rely on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Apps should catch SIGTERM, stop accepting work, drain in-flight requests and exit — orchestrators rely on this for rolling deploys.", what does "rely on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rely on /rɪˈlaɪ ɒn/ (cụm từ): dựa vào. "Rely on X" = phụ thuộc, tin cậy vào X; tính từ "reliable" = đáng tin cậy.
items.explanationEn: rely on /rɪˈlaɪ ɒn/ (phrase): to depend on. "Rely on X" means depending on X; the adjective is "reliable".

items.question: Trong câu "PID 1 is special: the kernel applies no default signal action to it, so an app with no SIGTERM handler ignores the signal; it must also reap zombie children.", từ "reap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "PID 1 is special: the kernel applies no default signal action to it, so an app with no SIGTERM handler ignores the signal; it must also reap zombie children.", what does "reap" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reap /riːp/ (động từ): thu dọn (tiến trình con). Trong Unix, "reap zombie processes" = thu dọn tiến trình con đã kết thúc; nghĩa gốc là gặt hái.
items.explanationEn: reap /riːp/ (verb): to clean up finished children. In Unix, "reap zombie processes" means collecting finished children; literally, harvesting.

items.question: Trong câu "PID 1 is special: the kernel applies no default signal action to it, so an app with no SIGTERM handler ignores the signal; it must also reap zombie children.", từ "handler" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "PID 1 is special: the kernel applies no default signal action to it, so an app with no SIGTERM handler ignores the signal; it must also reap zombie children.", what does "handler" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: code that responds to an event
items.explanation: handler /ˈhændlə(r)/ (danh từ): hàm xử lý (sự kiện). "Signal/event handler" = hàm được gọi khi có tín hiệu/sự kiện; "dog handler" = người quản lý chó.
items.explanationEn: handler /ˈhændlə(r)/ (noun): code that responds to an event. A "signal handler" is code run when a signal arrives; a "dog handler" trains dogs.

items.question: Trong câu "Exited containers keep their writable layer until docker rm — a common way build servers run out of disk.", từ "run out of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Exited containers keep their writable layer until docker rm — a common way build servers run out of disk.", what does "run out of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: run out of /rʌn aʊt əv/ (cụm từ): hết sạch. "Run out of X" = dùng hết X; "run out of disk/memory" rất phổ biến.
items.explanationEn: run out of /rʌn aʊt əv/ (phrase): to use up completely. "Run out of X" means having none left; "run out of disk" is very common.

items.question: Trong câu "-v and --mount do the same job, but for a bind mount --mount errors if the host path is missing while -v silently creates an empty directory — a classic "my config vanished".", từ "silently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "-v and --mount do the same job, but for a bind mount --mount errors if the host path is missing while -v silently creates an empty directory — a classic "my config vanished".", what does "silently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: silently /ˈsaɪləntli/ (trạng từ): không báo gì. "Fail silently" = lỗi mà không có thông báo; rất nguy hiểm khi gỡ lỗi.
items.explanationEn: silently /ˈsaɪləntli/ (adverb): without any warning. "Fail silently" means failing with no message, which makes debugging hard.

items.question: Trong câu "-v and --mount do the same job, but for a bind mount --mount errors if the host path is missing while -v silently creates an empty directory — a classic "my config vanished".", từ "classic" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "-v and --mount do the same job, but for a bind mount --mount errors if the host path is missing while -v silently creates an empty directory — a classic "my config vanished".", what does "classic" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: classic /ˈklæsɪk/ (danh từ): trường hợp điển hình. "A classic (mistake)" = ví dụ điển hình, hay gặp; cũng có nghĩa tác phẩm kinh điển.
items.explanationEn: classic /ˈklæsɪk/ (noun): a typical example. "A classic" can mean a typical, well-known case; it also means a timeless work.

items.question: Trong câu "A volume is still local to one host: reschedule the container elsewhere and the data stays behind.", từ "reschedule" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A volume is still local to one host: reschedule the container elsewhere and the data stays behind.", what does "reschedule" (verb) mean?
options: bố trí chạy lại chỗ khác
optionsEn: to place again on another node
items.explanation: reschedule /ˌriːˈʃedjuːl/ (động từ): bố trí chạy lại chỗ khác. Với orchestrator, "reschedule a pod/container" = đặt nó chạy trên node khác; thường ngày là dời lịch hẹn.
items.explanationEn: reschedule /ˌriːˈʃedjuːl/ (verb): to place again on another node. For orchestrators, "reschedule" means placing a workload on another node; in daily life it means moving an appointment.

items.question: Trong câu "A volume is still local to one host: reschedule the container elsewhere and the data stays behind.", từ "stay behind" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A volume is still local to one host: reschedule the container elsewhere and the data stays behind.", what does "stay behind" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: stay behind /steɪ bɪˈhaɪnd/ (cụm từ): bị bỏ lại. "Stay behind" = ở lại chỗ cũ khi thứ khác rời đi.
items.explanationEn: stay behind /steɪ bɪˈhaɪnd/ (phrase): to remain where it was. "Stay behind" means remaining in place when others leave.

items.question: Trong câu "Production databases therefore use managed services (RDS) or network storage (EBS/EFS) wired in by the orchestrator.", từ "therefore" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Production databases therefore use managed services (RDS) or network storage (EBS/EFS) wired in by the orchestrator.", what does "therefore" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: therefore /ˈðeəfɔː(r)/ (trạng từ): do đó. "Therefore" nối kết luận với lý do phía trước; tương đương "so", "thus".
items.explanationEn: therefore /ˈðeəfɔː(r)/ (adverb): for that reason. "Therefore" links a conclusion to the reason before it, like "so" or "thus".

items.question: Trong câu "Production databases therefore use managed services (RDS) or network storage (EBS/EFS) wired in by the orchestrator.", từ "wire in" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Production databases therefore use managed services (RDS) or network storage (EBS/EFS) wired in by the orchestrator.", what does "wire in" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: wire in /waɪə(r) ɪn/ (cụm từ): kết nối, gắn vào. "Wire X in" = tích hợp, kết nối X vào hệ thống; "wire money" = chuyển khoản.
items.explanationEn: wire in /waɪə(r) ɪn/ (phrase): to connect into a system. "Wire X in" means connecting X into a system; "wire money" means a bank transfer.

items.question: Trong câu "A user-defined bridge adds embedded DNS (127.0.0.11) that resolves container names, and isolates groups of containers:", từ "embedded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?

options: được tích hợp sẵn bên trong
items.explanation: embedded /ɪmˈbedɪd/ (tính từ): được tích hợp sẵn bên trong. "Embedded DNS/database" = thành phần gắn sẵn bên trong; "embedded systems" = hệ thống nhúng.
items.explanationEn: embedded /ɪmˈbedɪd/ (adjective): built in as a part. "Embedded DNS" is built into the platform; "embedded systems" are dedicated computers inside devices.

items.question: Trong câu "A user-defined bridge adds embedded DNS (127.0.0.11) that resolves container names, and isolates groups of containers:", từ "resolve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

optionsEn: to translate a name to an address
items.explanation: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (động từ): phân giải (tên thành IP). "Resolve a hostname" = tra ra địa chỉ IP; "resolve an issue" = giải quyết vấn đề.
items.explanationEn: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (verb): to translate a name to an address. "Resolve a hostname" means finding its IP; "resolve an issue" means fixing it.

items.question: Trong câu "Gotchas from real incidents:", từ "incident" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Gotchas from real incidents:", what does "incident" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: incident /ˈɪnsɪdənt/ (danh từ): sự cố vận hành. "Production incident" = sự cố trên hệ thống thật; "incident response" = ứng phó sự cố.
items.explanationEn: incident /ˈɪnsɪdənt/ (noun): an operational failure. A "production incident" is a live system failure; "incident response" is handling it.

items.question: Trong câu "-p 8080:3000 binds all host interfaces; use -p 127.0.0.1:8080:3000 for local-only.", từ "bind" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

optionsEn: to attach a port to an address
to put a cover on a book
items.explanation: bind /baɪnd/ (động từ): gắn (cổng vào địa chỉ). "Bind to a port/address" = gắn socket vào địa chỉ; "legally binding" = có tính ràng buộc pháp lý.
items.explanationEn: bind /baɪnd/ (verb): to attach a port to an address. "Bind to a port" attaches a socket to an address; "legally binding" means creating obligations.

items.question: Trong câu "-p 8080:3000 binds all host interfaces; use -p 127.0.0.1:8080:3000 for local-only.", từ "interface" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "-p 8080:3000 binds all host interfaces; use -p 127.0.0.1:8080:3000 for local-only.", what does "interface" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: interface /ˈɪntəfeɪs/ (danh từ): giao diện mạng. "Network interface" như eth0, lo; "user interface" (UI) là màn hình người dùng thao tác.
items.explanationEn: interface /ˈɪntəfeɪs/ (noun): a network adapter. A "network interface" is e.g. eth0 or lo; a "user interface" is what users interact with.

items.question: Trong câu "Docker's iptables rules can bypass ufw — a "blocked" database port may be public.", từ "bypass" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Docker's iptables rules can bypass ufw — a "blocked" database port may be public.", what does "bypass" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bypass /ˈbaɪpɑːs/ (động từ): đi vòng qua, lách qua. "Bypass a firewall/check" = lách qua kiểm soát; "heart bypass" = phẫu thuật bắc cầu tim.
items.explanationEn: bypass /ˈbaɪpɑːs/ (verb): to go around a control. "Bypass a firewall" means getting around it; a "heart bypass" is a surgery.

items.question: Trong câu "EXPOSE publishes nothing; -P maps every exposed port to a random high host port.", từ "random" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "EXPOSE publishes nothing; -P maps every exposed port to a random high host port.", what does "random" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: random /ˈrændəm/ (tính từ): ngẫu nhiên. "Random port/value" = chọn ngẫu nhiên, không đoán trước; "at random" = một cách ngẫu nhiên.
items.explanationEn: random /ˈrændəm/ (adjective): chosen by chance. "Random port" means chosen unpredictably; "at random" is the adverbial phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "A registry serves images over the OCI distribution API: Docker Hub, Amazon ECR, GitHub ghcr.io, Harbor, or the self-hosted registry image (port 5000).", từ "self-hosted" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A registry serves images over the OCI distribution API: Docker Hub, Amazon ECR, GitHub ghcr.io, Harbor, or the self-hosted registry image (port 5000).", what does "self-hosted" (adjective) mean?
options: tự vận hành trên máy mình
items.explanation: self-hosted /ˌself ˈhəʊstɪd/ (tính từ): tự vận hành trên máy mình. "Self-hosted" = tự triển khai trên hạ tầng của mình, đối lập với dịch vụ "managed/SaaS".
items.explanationEn: self-hosted /ˌself ˈhəʊstɪd/ (adjective): run on your own servers. "Self-hosted" means running on your own infrastructure, as opposed to a managed or SaaS service.

items.question: Trong câu "A tag is a mutable pointer; latest is only the default tag name, not "newest".", từ "mutable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A tag is a mutable pointer; latest is only the default tag name, not "newest".", what does "mutable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mutable /ˈmjuːtəbl/ (tính từ): có thể thay đổi. "Mutable" = thay đổi được, đối nghĩa "immutable"; tag có thể trỏ sang image khác.
items.explanationEn: mutable /ˈmjuːtəbl/ (adjective): able to be changed. "Mutable" means changeable, the opposite of "immutable"; a tag can be moved to another image.

items.question: Trong câu "A tag is a mutable pointer; latest is only the default tag name, not "newest".", từ "pointer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A tag is a mutable pointer; latest is only the default tag name, not "newest".", what does "pointer" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pointer /ˈpɔɪntə(r)/ (danh từ): tham chiếu trỏ tới. "Pointer" = thứ trỏ tới một đối tượng khác; "a few pointers" = vài lời khuyên.
items.explanationEn: pointer /ˈpɔɪntə(r)/ (noun): a reference to a target. A "pointer" refers to another object; "a few pointers" means some tips.

items.question: Trong câu "A digest is the manifest's hash and never changes — pin by digest or use immutable tags (ECR supports them) for reproducible deploys.", từ "pin" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A digest is the manifest's hash and never changes — pin by digest or use immutable tags (ECR supports them) for reproducible deploys.", what does "pin" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to lock to an exact version
items.explanation: pin /pɪn/ (động từ): cố định (phiên bản). "Pin a version/dependency" = cố định phiên bản; "pin the blame on" = đổ lỗi cho.
items.explanationEn: pin /pɪn/ (verb): to lock to an exact version. "Pin a version" means locking it; "pin the blame on someone" means blaming them.

items.question: Trong câu "A digest is the manifest's hash and never changes — pin by digest or use immutable tags (ECR supports them) for reproducible deploys.", từ "reproducible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A digest is the manifest's hash and never changes — pin by digest or use immutable tags (ECR supports them) for reproducible deploys.", what does "reproducible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reproducible /ˌriːprəˈdjuːsəbl/ (tính từ): tái tạo được y hệt. "Reproducible builds/deploys" = chạy lại cho kết quả giống hệt; "reproduce a bug" = tái hiện lỗi.
items.explanationEn: reproducible /ˌriːprəˈdjuːsəbl/ (adjective): able to be repeated identically. "Reproducible builds" give identical results each time; "reproduce a bug" means triggering it again.

items.question: Trong câu "Docker Hub rate-limits pulls for anonymous and free users, which breaks CI and node scale-outs.", từ "anonymous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Docker Hub rate-limits pulls for anonymous and free users, which breaks CI and node scale-outs.", what does "anonymous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: anonymous /əˈnɒnɪməs/ (tính từ): ẩn danh, chưa đăng nhập. "Anonymous user/access" = truy cập không xác thực danh tính.
items.explanationEn: anonymous /əˈnɒnɪməs/ (adjective): not identified or logged in. "Anonymous access" means using a service without identifying yourself.

items.question: Trong câu "Mirror base images into your own registry (e.g. ECR pull-through cache).", từ "mirror" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Mirror base images into your own registry (e.g. ECR pull-through cache).", what does "mirror" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mirror /ˈmɪrə(r)/ (động từ): sao chép đồng bộ. "Mirror a repository" = tạo bản sao đồng bộ; nghĩa gốc là soi gương, phản chiếu.
items.explanationEn: mirror /ˈmɪrə(r)/ (verb): to keep a synced copy. "Mirror a repository" means keeping a synced copy; literally, to reflect.

items.question: Trong câu "Log to stdout; every log collector builds on that convention.", từ "convention" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Log to stdout; every log collector builds on that convention.", what does "convention" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: convention /kənˈvenʃn/ (danh từ): quy ước chung. "By convention" = theo quy ước; "naming convention" = quy ước đặt tên; còn nghĩa "hội nghị".
items.explanationEn: convention /kənˈvenʃn/ (noun): an agreed common practice. "By convention" means by agreed practice; "naming convention" is common; it also means a conference.

items.question: Trong câu "Log to stdout; every log collector builds on that convention.", từ "build on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Log to stdout; every log collector builds on that convention.", what does "build on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: build on /bɪld ɒn/ (cụm từ): dựa trên để phát triển. "Build on X" = lấy X làm nền tảng để phát triển tiếp.
items.explanationEn: build on /bɪld ɒn/ (phrase): to use as a foundation. "Build on X" means using X as a foundation for further work.

items.question: Trong câu "Stack: CLI → dockerd → containerd → runc; OCI makes images portable to containerd, CRI-O, Podman.", từ "portable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stack: CLI → dockerd → containerd → runc; OCI makes images portable to containerd, CRI-O, Podman.", what does "portable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: portable /ˈpɔːtəbl/ (tính từ): chạy được ở nơi khác. "Portable to X" = chuyển sang chạy trên X được; "portable speaker" = loa di động.
items.explanationEn: portable /ˈpɔːtəbl/ (adjective): usable on other platforms. "Portable to X" means it can run on X; a "portable speaker" is easy to carry.

items.question: Trong câu "Containers ship an app with its dependencies and start in under a second on any compatible Linux kernel.", từ "compatible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Containers ship an app with its dependencies and start in under a second on any compatible Linux kernel.", what does "compatible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: compatible /kəmˈpætəbl/ (tính từ): tương thích. "Compatible with X" = tương thích với X; danh từ "compatibility".
items.explanationEn: compatible /kəmˈpætəbl/ (adjective): able to work together. "Compatible with X" means working with X; the noun is "compatibility".

items.question: Trong câu "Namespaces and cgroups are kernel features; Docker assembles them via containerd and runc.", từ "assemble" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Namespaces and cgroups are kernel features; Docker assembles them via containerd and runc.", what does "assemble" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: assemble /əˈsembl/ (động từ): lắp ráp, kết hợp. "Assemble parts" = lắp ráp; "people assemble" = mọi người tập trung.
items.explanationEn: assemble /əˈsembl/ (verb): to put parts together. "Assemble parts" means putting them together; "people assemble" means they gather.

items.question: Trong câu "Signals and exit codes explain graceful shutdowns and crashes.", từ "graceful" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Signals and exit codes explain graceful shutdowns and crashes.", what does "graceful" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: graceful /ˈɡreɪsfl/ (tính từ): êm, có trật tự. "Graceful shutdown/degradation" = tắt/suy giảm có trật tự; "graceful dancer" = người múa duyên dáng.
items.explanationEn: graceful /ˈɡreɪsfl/ (adjective): orderly, without abrupt failure. "Graceful shutdown" means stopping in an orderly way; a "graceful dancer" moves elegantly.

items.question: Trong câu "Pick volumes, bind mounts or tmpfs deliberately; use user-defined networks; publish only what must be reachable.", từ "deliberately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pick volumes, bind mounts or tmpfs deliberately; use user-defined networks; publish only what must be reachable.", what does "deliberately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: deliberately /dɪˈlɪbərətli/ (trạng từ): có chủ đích. "Deliberately" = cân nhắc kỹ, cố ý; đối nghĩa "accidentally".
items.explanationEn: deliberately /dɪˈlɪbərətli/ (adverb): on purpose, with thought. "Deliberately" means intentionally and carefully; the opposite is "accidentally".

items.question: Trong câu "Pick volumes, bind mounts or tmpfs deliberately; use user-defined networks; publish only what must be reachable.", từ "reachable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pick volumes, bind mounts or tmpfs deliberately; use user-defined networks; publish only what must be reachable.", what does "reachable" (adjective) mean?
options: liên lạc được bằng điện thoại
items.explanation: reachable /ˈriːtʃəbl/ (tính từ): truy cập được. "Reachable from the internet" = có thể truy cập từ internet; "unreachable host" = không kết nối được.
items.explanationEn: reachable /ˈriːtʃəbl/ (adjective): able to be accessed. "Reachable from the internet" means accessible over the network; an "unreachable host" cannot be contacted.
